title: Time-budget experiment
question: On a free-tier server (512 MB, no swap, 0.1 CPU), how close does the optimizer get to the best known plan, and how fast?
design: Each contractor solved at 10, 60, 300 and 600 s, 3 repeats, limited and unlimited, plus one 30-minute unlimited reference. 50 runs, about 4.5 hours. Limits applied with systemd cgroups in WSL.

title: Query-budget experiment
question: How few real travel-time queries (each stop's K nearest stops plus its leg to campus, the rest estimated) still give routes within 3% of the full matrix?
design: K = 0, 3, 5, 10, 20, 40 with two estimators (straight-line fit, shortest path through queried legs) plus the full matrix as control; 2 contractors, 3 repeats, 60 s unlimited search. Plans are scored on real OSRM times. 72 runs, about 40 minutes on 2 cores.

title: Pipeline test
question: Does the whole experiment pipeline work? 5 s runs, about 1 minute. Not a reported result.
design: One 5 s run per contractor and setup, plus a 10 s reference.

title: Query-budget pipeline test
question: Does the query-budget pipeline work? 5 s runs, about 20 seconds. Not a reported result.
design: K = 10 with both estimators plus the full matrix, 1 repeat.
